mods.description: Adds decoupled look + aim to Subnautica via OpenTrack. Your head moves the camera, the mouse still controls aim and the gun reticle. Works in first-person and while piloting the Seamoth / PRAWN.
features: Head moves the view; mouse + aim stay independent
6DOF position tracking (peek around corners, lean into HUD)
Auto-recenters on first packet after a reconnect
Pauses automatically in menus, loading screens, cutscenes
UI/canvas compensation - HUD markers stay where they should

mods.description: Head tracking for Lucas Pope's murder mystery. Lean in to examine the frozen moments, look around each deck naturally, keep the mouse for pointing at what you want to inspect.
features: Decoupled look + aim - your head moves the view, mouse still picks targets
6DOF position tracking for cinematic leans during memories
Pauses cleanly during menus + the book UI

mods.description: An unofficial BepInEx mod that adds head tracking to PEAK via OpenTrack. Look around naturally with your head while your aim stays independent.
features: Decoupled look + aim: Look around freely with your head while your crosshair stays where you're aiming
6DOF head tracking: Full rotation (yaw, pitch, roll) and positional tracking via OpenTrack UDP protocol
requirements: OpenTrack or a compatible head tracking app (smartphone, webcam, or dedicated hardware)

setup_steps: Click the Download button above. It opens outerwildsmods.com - the community-run hub for Outer Wilds mods.
On the page, click the big 'Download Mod Manager' button. Run the installer it hands you, then open the Mod Manager app.

In the Mod Manager, click the 'Get More Mods' tab. In the search box type 'Head Tracking' and click Install on our mod. The Mod Manager also grabs OWML (the mod loader) for you on first run - nothing manual.

Make sure OpenTrack is running. In OpenTrack: set 'Output' to 'freetrack 2.0 Enhanced', click the gear next to it, and tick 'Both'. Don't have OpenTrack yet? Grab it free from github.com/opentrack/opentrack/releases.
Back in the Mod Manager, click the big green 'Run Game' button. That launches Outer Wilds with OWML + our mod loaded - starting from Steam won't work.
Hotkeys (recenter, toggle tracking) live in the Mod Manager: click 'Head Tracking' in the mod list → Settings.
setup_steps_installed: Click 'Open Mod Manager' above to launch it.
In the Mod Manager, check your mod list - if 'Head Tracking' isn't there yet, hit the 'Get More Mods' tab, search 'Head Tracking' and click Install. OWML is handled automatically.
Make sure OpenTrack is running with Output = 'freetrack 2.0 Enhanced' and Interface = 'Both'. Not set up yet? Grab it free from github.com/opentrack/opentrack/releases.
Back in the Mod Manager, click the big green 'Run Game' button. Launching Outer Wilds from Steam won't load OWML - it has to be through the Mod Manager.
Hotkeys (recenter, toggle tracking) live in the Mod Manager: click 'Head Tracking' in the mod list → Settings.

native_games.notes: Native TrackIR; OpenTrack reachable via headset-emulator output.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR (or OpenTrack with Output = 'freetrack 2.0 Enhanced', Interface = 'Both') BEFORE launching the game.
Elite auto-detects TrackIR/FreeTrack - there's no in-game toggle to flip.
Press F9 in-game to pause tracking; use Numpad 5 on your TrackIR profile to recenter.

native_games.notes: Built-in TrackIR; OpenTrack via native export; VR headset supported.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR (or OpenTrack with Output = 'freetrack 2.0 Enhanced') BEFORE launching DCS.
DCS detects the tracker automatically - nothing to enable in Options.
In-cockpit: press F9 to toggle tracking pause, Numpad 5 to recenter.
For OpenTrack users without TrackIR software, tick 'Both (TrackIR + FreeTrack)' in the FreeTrack output settings.

native_games.notes: SimConnect integration; OpenTrack works via TrackIR output protocol.
setup_steps: Update the TrackIR software first (Help → Check for game updates) - MSFS 2024 requires a recent profile.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack BEFORE MSFS; both apps must run at the same admin level (both as admin, or neither).
Uninstall any competing tracker software (Tobii Game Hub etc) - they can silently toggle TrackIR off.
In-game: Options → Camera → flip the 'TrackIR' switch to On.
If still not detected, run the 'Camera' section's 'Reset all to defaults' then re-enable.

native_games.notes: SimConnect-based; same driver chain as MSFS 2024.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE MSFS 2020.
In-game: Options → Camera → 'TrackIR Enabled' → On.
If TrackIR isn't picked up, make sure both the tracker and MSFS are running at the same admin level.
Numpad 5 recenters the view; Options → Camera → 'Reset Camera View' rebinds the hotkey if collision.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE iRacing.
iRacing auto-detects TrackIR - no in-game enable required.
Recenter the view with the semicolon (;) key (Recenter HMD); Y recenters tilt only.
Tune head behaviour via the in-sim Camera Tool: from the session screen press Ctrl+F12 to open it and adjust 'Driver Head Horizon' (Roll / Pitch chassis) and related sliders.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE Assetto Corsa.
AC auto-detects TrackIR and FreeTrack - no menu toggle.
In-game: Options → View → set 'Lock onto Horizon' to ~50% for natural motion.
If using Content Manager: Settings → Content Manager → Miscellaneous → enable the TrackIR profile.
Edit <Documents>\Assetto Corsa\cfg\camera_onboard.ini for fine tuning (FOV, head offsets).
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE ACC.
ACC auto-detects TrackIR - there's no in-game on/off toggle.
In-game: Settings → View → set 'Lock to Horizon' to ~50% for a natural feel.
In the TrackIR software's ACC profile, tick 'Exclusive' (under Advanced) or the rotation can double-apply.
If the view jumps on session start, ESC → Default the camera offset, then save.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE rFactor 2.
rF2 auto-detects TrackIR; no in-game enable required.

For stronger head-look, edit <rFactor 2 install>\UserData\player\player.JSON (inside the Steam game folder, not Documents). Raise 'Glance Angle' (default 0.75) to 2-3 and/or bump 'Head Rotation' under 'Graphic Options' to 0.3-0.7.
Numpad 5 recenters; F9 pauses TrackIR.

native_games.notes: Widely used in milsim; FreeTrack support configurable.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE Arma 3.

In-game: Options -> Controls -> Controllers tab -> click 'TrackIR' in the device list and tick 'Enable TrackIR'. Leave the raw 'FreeTrack' device disabled; OpenTrack's TrackIR output is what the game reads.
Configure Controls -> search 'TrackIR' to optionally bind a pause key.
Options -> Game -> turn off 'Head bob' so it does not compound with tracker motion.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE War Thunder.
In-game: Options → Controls → Controls Setup → set Control Setup mode to 'Custom'.
Navigate to the 'Camera' section → enable 'Track IR' and bind the axes if they're blank.
Head tracking only applies in cockpit / periscope views - third-person is fixed.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE IL-2.
IL-2 Great Battles auto-detects TrackIR - there is no in-game enable toggle. Make sure the TrackIR software recognises the game (update the game list if it doesn't appear).
Settings -> Controls -> Camera -> 'Camera head rotation' is where you'd optionally rebind the software fallback look keys; you do not need to bind anything for TrackIR.
F9 pauses TrackIR in-cockpit; Numpad 5 recenters.

native_games.notes: Shares the Great Battles engine.
setup_steps: Same engine as IL-2 Great Battles - instructions identical.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE launching.
Auto-detected; no in-game enable toggle.
F9 pauses TrackIR; Numpad 5 recenters.

native_games.notes: Legacy classic; FreeTrack via the community modpack.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE IL-2 1946.
Open <IL-2 1946>\conf.ini in a text editor.
Under the [HotKeys game] section, set TrackIRUse=1 and save.
For FreeTrack users, drop the community FreeTrack DLL into the game's root folder (the HSFX / modpack installer does this automatically).

native_games.notes: Not on Steam; community F-16 sim. Install path must be set via env or manual override.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE BMS. Keep OpenTrack's FreeTrack output disabled - BMS is TrackIR-only.
Launch BMS -> Setup (top-right) -> Controllers -> Advanced -> View Control tab.
Tick both 'Enable 2d cockpit TrackIR' and 'Enable 3d cockpit TrackIR', then Apply.
In-cockpit: F9 pauses TrackIR, Numpad 5 recenters, Alt+C realigns the pit view.

native_games.notes: Native TrackIR checkbox in settings.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE X-Plane 12. Running both X-Plane and the tracker as administrator avoids detection issues.
In-game: Settings -> 'VR and Head Tracking' tab -> tick 'Enable TrackIR/TrackHat/Beam Eye Tracker'.
In-cockpit: Numpad 5 recenters; bind 'Toggle TrackIR control' under Settings -> Keyboard if you want a mid-flight pause.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE X-Plane 11; run both as administrator to avoid detection issues.
In-game: Settings -> Graphics -> tick the TrackIR checkbox, then Settings -> Keyboard -> search 'trackir' and bind 'Toggle TrackIR control' to a key or joystick button for mid-flight pause/resume.
In-cockpit: Numpad 5 recenters; use your bound Toggle key to pause head tracking.

native_games.notes: Lockheed Martin; not on Steam. SimConnect-based; TrackIR requires ChasePlane or ViewTracker - P3D v6 has no native menu toggle.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE P3D.
P3D v6 does NOT have a built-in 'TrackIR Enable' menu - install ChasePlane Pro (recommended) or ViewTracker and use it as the bridge.
In ChasePlane -> Preferences, tick 'Enable Head Tracking (TrackIR)'. In ViewTracker set Output = 'Prepar3D SimConnect'.
Numpad 5 recenters; F9 pauses the tracker.

native_games.notes: Classic Flight Simulator X; TrackIR has been supported since launch.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE FSX.
FSX auto-detects TrackIR via the NaturalPoint dll bundled with the game (NPClient.dll in the FSX root).
If tracking doesn't register, copy NPClient.dll from %ProgramFiles(x86)%\NaturalPoint\TrackIR5\ into the FSX folder (some regional builds ship without it).
In-cockpit: F9 pauses, Numpad 5 recenters.

native_games.notes: Open-source flight sim; uses FlightGear's native UDP protocol.
setup_steps: In OpenTrack, add Output = 'UDP over network'; set Host = 127.0.0.1, port = 4242.
In the FlightGear Launcher: Settings → Additional Settings → add --props=socket,in,30,127.0.0.1,5501,udp to the additional arguments.
Launch your aircraft. In the cockpit: View → Adjust View → Auto-center, then head motion tracks OpenTrack input.
For more granular setup see wiki.flightgear.org/TrackIR - community-maintained and covers alt tracker protocols.

native_games.notes: Not on Steam (RSI launcher). Native TrackIR.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE launching Star Citizen.
In-game: Options menu → 'Comms, FoIP & Head Tracking' tab.
Under 'Head Tracking' set Source → 'TrackIR', then Enabled → On.
Sensitivity sliders (Yaw/Pitch/Roll) live in the same panel - default 1.0 is usually too aggressive, 0.4-0.6 feels natural.

native_games.notes: Free spaceflight simulator; distributed via orbiter-forum.com.
setup_steps: Download the TrackIR plugin from orbiter-forum.com (search 'OrbiterTrackIR').
Drop OrbiterTrackIR.dll into <Orbiter2016>\Modules\Plugin\.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE Orbiter.
Launch Orbiter → Modules tab → enable 'TrackIR' checkbox.
In-cockpit mode only: virtual cockpit view honours tracking; 2D panel view does not.

native_games.notes: TrackIR only works when AMS 2 is launched in SteamVR mode; there is no in-game TrackIR toggle.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE AMS 2.
In Steam: right-click Automobilista 2 -> Properties -> Launch Options -> add '-forceVR'. (Or use the shortcut URL steam://launch/1066890/vr.) AMS 2 only reads TrackIR in VR mode.
In-game: Options -> Camera -> Configuration - set 'Show Helmet' off and 'Helmet look to apex' to 0 so the sim's own head motion doesn't fight the tracker.
Switch to Helmet-cam (1 key in-car); TrackIR is inactive in chase and cockpit cams.
Update the TrackIR software's game list (top-right refresh) so the RaceRoom profile is present.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE RaceRoom.
R3E auto-detects TrackIR once the profile is in the game list - there is no in-game enable toggle.
Press F12 once seated to set the centre point; adjust head motion intensity via Options -> Graphics -> 'Head Motion' sliders.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE pCARS2.
pCARS2 only reads TrackIR when launched in SteamVR mode - right-click the game in Steam -> Properties -> Launch Options and add '-vr' (or launch via steam://launch/234630/vr).
In-car, switch to Helmet-cam (1 key) - TrackIR is inactive in the non-helmet cockpit and chase cams.
Options -> Visuals -> tune 'Edge Peek' and 'G-Force Effect Strength' so the sim's own sway does not compound with the tracker.

native_games.notes: TrackIR added post-launch.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE DR2.
DR2 auto-detects TrackIR since v1.2 - no in-game menu toggle.
Head motion only shows in Dashcam, Bonnet and Hood views; the chase cams ignore it.
If TrackIR isn't responding, check Settings → Graphics → make sure you're not running in DX11 debug mode.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE BeamNG.
BeamNG detects TrackIR automatically via its bundled profile - no in-game enable.
Head tracking applies in Orbit and Interior (cockpit) cameras only.
For fine tuning: in the TrackIR software, load the BeamNG profile and start at 1:1 curves, then adjust as you go.

native_games.notes: Self-distributed from lfs.net; detected by folder match only.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE LFS.
LFS auto-detects TrackIR / FreeTrack via the bundled libraries.
In-game: Options → Controls → Axes → verify 'Look' and 'Tilt' are set to your TrackIR axes.
For advanced tuning, use the InSim protocol with a community TrackIR bridge script (see lfsforum.net).

native_games.notes: Legacy Simbin racing sim.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE GTR 2.
In-game: Options → Controls → Advanced Controller Settings → 'Use TrackIR' → Yes.
Head motion only appears in cockpit view.
If TrackIR isn't detected, copy NPClient.dll from your TrackIR install into the GTR 2 folder.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE ETS2.
ETS2 auto-detects TrackIR using its bundled profile - no in-game enable.
To fine-tune or turn off: edit <Documents>\Euro Truck Simulator 2\config.cfg and flip 'uset g_trackir' between 1 and 0.
If both TrackIR and Tobii Game Hub are installed, disable the Tobii ETS2 profile - otherwise TrackIR can get silently overridden.
Same engine as ETS2 - setup is identical.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE ATS.
ATS auto-detects TrackIR; toggle is 'uset g_trackir' in <Documents>\American Truck Simulator\config.cfg.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE FS22.
FS22 auto-detects TrackIR on startup - check log.txt in the game folder if uncertain ('TrackIR initialised' line).
In-game: Options → Controls → Camera → verify the 'Look' axes are mapped.
If TrackIR 5 doesn't recognise FS22, update your TrackIR software to v5.5+ (older versions predate the FS22 profile).

native_games.notes: No native TrackIR / FreeTrack support; UE4 title driven through mouse emulation.
setup_steps: TSW4 has NO native TrackIR or FreeTrack support - head look has to be emulated as mouse movement.
Install FreePIE (andersmalmgren.github.io/FreePIE/) and load a community TrackIR-to-mouse script; alternatively set OpenTrack's Output to 'mouse emulation'.
In-game: Settings -> Controls -> Camera -> hold the 'Free Look' key while driving the cab to engage the mouse-driven camera the tracker now controls.
External / drive-past cams ignore the tracker entirely.

native_games.notes: No native TrackIR / FreeTrack (NaturalPoint's NDA blocks integration in UE4). Head tracking via mouse emulation only.
setup_steps: Squad has NO native TrackIR or FreeTrack support.
In OpenTrack: Output = 'mouse emulation' and bind the tracker axes to mouse X/Y, or use FreePIE with a community TrackIR-to-mouse script.
In-game, hold the Alt (free-look) key while the tracker drives the mouse; releasing Alt returns aim to centre.
For combining with lean (Q/E), most players run a FreePIE script that maps tracker roll to key presses.
Hell Let Loose does NOT natively support TrackIR or FreeTrack as of 2026.
Community requests have been open since 2019; the UE4 implementation cost has kept it off the devs' roadmap.
Closest workaround: OpenTrack → 'mouse emulation' output, driving the free-look camera while you hold right-mouse. Feel is poor.
Track the official channels (hell-let-loose.com) for any future support announcement.

native_games.notes: Native TrackIR; VR mode also exposes tracking to emulated headsets.
setup_steps: Update your TrackIR software to v5.5+ (Help → Check for game updates).
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE launching Squadrons.
Squadrons auto-detects TrackIR since patch 4.0 - no in-game enable.
Don't bind F9 to anything in-game; it's the standard TrackIR pause hotkey.

native_games.notes: OpenTrack via FreePIE bridge; no native TrackIR.
setup_steps: Project Wingman has no native TrackIR support (Ace Combat clone - by design).
Install FreePIE from andersmalmgren.github.io/FreePIE/.
In OpenTrack, set Output = 'FreePIE UDP' and run the community PW bridge script that maps OpenTrack yaw/pitch to right-stick axes.
In-game: bind 'Look' to the emulated right-stick via Options → Controls.
Start TrackIR (or OpenTrack with TrackIR output) BEFORE HAWX.
HAWX auto-detects TrackIR via the bundled NPClient.dll in the game root.
In-game: Options → Controls → 'Free Look' - axes are pre-mapped to TrackIR.
Numpad 5 recenters; F9 pauses the tracker.
Same setup as the first HAWX.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE launching.
Auto-detected via NPClient.dll; no in-game toggle.
If tracking isn't picked up, copy NPClient.dll from your TrackIR install into the HAWX 2 folder.
Update the TrackIR game list first; start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE F1 2019.
In-game: Settings -> Camera -> set 'Head tracking with TrackIR' to On, then restart the game for the setting to take effect. If the option is greyed out, update the TrackIR game list and relaunch.
Reduce Settings -> Graphics -> 'Camera Movement' so the sim's baseline sway does not fight the tracker.
Head tracking applies in cockpit / helmet / t-cam views only.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE F1 2020; keep the TrackIR game list current or the toggle stays greyed out.
Settings -> Camera -> 'Head tracking with TrackIR' -> On, then restart the game.
Settings -> Graphics -> reduce 'Camera Movement' so the sim's sway does not compound with the tracker.
Head tracking only shows in cockpit / helmet / t-cam views.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE F1 23.

The TrackIR enable toggle is only available during a session, not in the main menu: start any race / time trial, pause, then Settings (gear icon) -> 'Eye and Head Tracking' -> 'Head Tracking with TrackIR' -> On.
Settings -> Graphics -> reduce 'Camera Movement' so the sim's built-in sway doesn't fight the tracker.
Head tracking only responds in cockpit / helmet / t-cam views.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE F1 24.
TrackIR can only be enabled in-session: start a race / time trial, pause, then Settings (gear icon) -> 'Eye and Head Tracking' -> 'Head Tracking with TrackIR' -> On.
Settings -> Graphics -> 'Camera Movement' slider tunes the sim's baseline sway.
Head tracking only applies in cockpit / helmet / t-cam views.

native_games.notes: Yaw/pitch in dashcam and bonnet views; predecessor to DR2.0.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE DiRT Rally.
DiRT Rally auto-detects TrackIR - no in-game toggle needed.
Head tracking only appears in Dashcam and Bonnet views (no cockpit-to-wheel translation).
If tracking doesn't register, confirm the DR profile is active in TrackIR (Advanced → Profiles → DirtRally).

native_games.notes: Codemasters EGO engine; same head-tracking chain as the DiRT Rally titles.
setup_steps: Same as DiRT Rally / DR2.0 - EGO engine.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE DiRT 4.
Auto-detected; head motion applies in Dashcam and Bonnet views only.

native_games.notes: No native TrackIR / FreeTrack as of 2026 - Codemasters chose not to port the DR2.0 driver. VR is supported via SteamVR.
setup_steps: EA SPORTS WRC has NO native TrackIR or FreeTrack support (confirmed unsupported through 2025).
If you already use SteamVR, launch WRC in VR and let the headset drive head look - this is the only 'native' path.
For flat-screen play, install FreePIE + vJoy and run the community TrackIR-to-vJoy bridge; in-game bind the emulated stick to the Look Left/Right/Up/Down axes under Settings -> Controls.
Head motion (mod or native VR) shows in Dashcam / Bonnet / Cockpit views only.

native_games.notes: Foundational sim racing title; TrackIR since 2005.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE rFactor.
rFactor auto-detects TrackIR (no menu toggle - the 'Look' axes are pre-bound).
In-game: Options → Controls → 'Look' axes for manual rebinding if needed.
Head motion only appears in cockpit / onboard views.

native_games.notes: Classic 2004 rally sim; TrackIR since 2004. Not on Steam; distributed via RSRBR community pack.
setup_steps: Install the RSRBR / NGP community mod pack from rallysimfans.hu - native RBR predates modern Windows and the mod pack fixes compatibility.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE RBR.
RBR auto-detects TrackIR via the bundled library (rbr_trackir.dll).
Head motion shows in cockpit view only; external cams are fixed.

native_games.display_name: Rise of Flight: The First Great Air War
native_games.notes: WWI flight sim; Options > Controls > Pilot Head Control.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE Rise of Flight.
In-game: Options → Controls → 'Pilot Head Control' section.
Bind your tracker's yaw / pitch / roll axes (TrackIR/FreeTrack both exposed as separate HID devices).
Numpad 5 recenters the view.

native_games.display_name: IL-2 Sturmovik: Cliffs of Dover Blitz
native_games.steam_folder: IL-2 Sturmovik Cliffs of Dover Blitz
native_games.notes: Battle-of-Britain flight sim; TrackIR full support post-Blitz remaster.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE launching CloD Blitz.
In-game: Options → Controls → Axes → bind TrackIR/FreeTrack pitch / yaw / roll under 'Camera'.
Blitz (the remaster) has full TrackIR; the original 2011 CloD needed config hacks - don't mix them up.
Numpad 5 recenters; F9 pauses TrackIR.

native_games.notes: Precursor to DCS (Flaming Cliffs lineage); TrackIR since 2004.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR (or OpenTrack with TrackIR output) BEFORE Lock On.
Auto-detected; no in-game menu toggle.
In-cockpit: F9 pauses TrackIR, Numpad 5 recenters.
Copy NPClient.dll from your TrackIR install into the Lock On folder if detection fails - older builds predate modern TrackIR autoloader.

native_games.notes: Third Wire jet combat sim; shared TrackIR profile across the SF2 family ('First Eagles, Wings Over Europe, Strike Fighters').
setup_steps: Start TrackIR (or OpenTrack with TrackIR output) BEFORE SF2. On Windows 10/11, right-click both the tracker and StrikeFighters2.exe -> 'Run as administrator'.
SF2 auto-detects TrackIR via NaturalPoint's shared 'First Eagles, Wings Over Europe, Strike Fighters' profile - there is no in-game toggle and no Options.ini edit required.
Once seated in the cockpit, press F12 to centre the view; F9 pauses TrackIR.

native_games.notes: MMO combat flight sim; TrackIR supported in cockpit views.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE Aces High III.
Launch AH3 → Options → Options tab → 'Track IR Enabled' → On.
Head motion applies in cockpit views only; external cams are fixed.
Numpad 5 recenters; F9 pauses the tracker.

native_games.notes: Via FreeSpace Open (SCP); requires the community DLL drop.
setup_steps: Use a FreeSpace Open (SCP) build rather than the stock 1999 exe - get one from scp.indiegames.us.
Copy NPClient.dll from your TrackIR install (or the FreeTrack equivalent) into the FreeSpace 2 folder.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE launching.
Use the FSO Launcher → Features tab → tick the 'TrackIR' / '-trackir' flag, then launch.

setup_steps: Wing Commander Saga is built on the same FSO engine as FreeSpace 2 - setup mirrors it.
Copy NPClient.dll from your TrackIR install into the Wing Commander Saga folder.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE launching.
TrackIR is auto-used in cockpit view once the DLL is in place.

native_games.notes: Enable via Settings > Game > Track IR Support. Some DX11 quirks reported.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE Everspace 2.
In-game: Settings → Game → 'Track IR Support' → On.
Prefer the DX12 backend if available; DX11 has jitter reports on older drivers.

native_games.notes: WWII combat sim on the ARMA 2 engine; same FreeTrack config path as ARMA.
setup_steps: Iron Front runs on the ARMA 2 engine - same tracker wiring.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (Interface = Both) BEFORE launching.

native_games.notes: TrackIR works in vehicle views only; on-foot needs GlovePIE/OpenTrack bridging.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR (or OpenTrack with TrackIR output) BEFORE Dragon Rising.
Dragon Rising auto-detects TrackIR in vehicle / aircraft views only.
On-foot head motion is NOT supported natively; workaround is a FreePIE or GlovePIE script that maps tracker yaw to look-keys.
Numpad 5 recenters; F9 pauses the tracker.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE FS19.
FS19 auto-detects TrackIR via its bundled profile on launch.
In-game: Options → Controls → Camera → verify the 'Look' axes are mapped.
Head motion applies in first-person views only.
Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE FS25.
FS25 has a first-class head-tracking UI: Options → General → 'Head Tracking' → Enable.
Pick 'TrackIR' from the device dropdown (Tobii is the alternative).
Sensitivity sliders (Yaw / Pitch / Roll) live in the same panel.

native_games.notes: Dovetail Games long-running train sim; TrackIR native since early releases.
setup_steps: Start TrackIR / OpenTrack (TrackIR output) BEFORE TSC.
TSC auto-detects TrackIR in first-person cab view.
If tracking doesn't register, confirm the 'RailWorks' profile is active in the TrackIR software.
External / passenger cams don't honour head tracking.

Install Tobii Game Hub from gaming.tobii.com and connect a Tobii Eye Tracker 5 (or 4C).

Calibration lives in Tobii Game Hub; recalibrate whenever you change your chair position.
